notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI implements the ask-once name discipline for the two main paths: player names by guid (CMSG_NAME_QUERY, _queriedPlayerNames dedupe set) and creature records by template entry (CMSG_CREATURE_QUERY with the full 5875 response decoded - name, subname, type flags, creature type, rank, civilian, racial leader - and the high-bit negative cached in _creatureQueryRecords). The unanswered-ask set is cleared on zoning so a dropped query is re-askable, matching Benilla's clear_pending.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Benilla's gated_rank law (a charmed/pet unit reports rank 0 regardless of template) has no visible single-source counterpart; MSUI reads CreatureQueryInfo.Rank directly where consumed - worth checking wherever elite borders/skulls are drawn.
